FAQ

## Questions, answered.

How is redu different from a traditional cloud platform?

redu is built on a new type of cloud orchestration that allows efficiency that was previously unthinkable, with an MCP server as its primary interface.

We specialize in providing speed and reliability to users with agents as their primary drivers. [...] If you are coming from a traditional cloud, your project can be easily converted to redu's workflows via agents.

How is it different from a PaaS like Vercel, Railway, or Render?

A PaaS is a managed slot to run your app in: push code and it runs, nothing to operate. That convenience is the whole appeal, and you pay for it by giving up the machine, their runtime, their limits, their margin.

redu is the real cloud itself: the actual VMs, networks, and databases you would otherwise never touch. Normally that means operating it yourself, so your agent does that instead, and you keep the convenience while getting the control back.

It is like owning the car instead of taking the taxi, except your agent does the driving, so you still just say where to go.

results.title: Cloud instances (VMs) on redu: real machines your agent operates | redu.cloud
results.content:
### Run it manually or with an agent

Create and operate an instance from the console or the API, like any cloud. Pointing your agent at it is an optional, faster interface to the same thing, not a requirement.

### Predictable, hourly pricing

Instances are billed by the hour with no per-unit tax. New accounts start on a free tier. See the pricing page for exact rates.

### Scales with you

Start with one instance and grow into an autoscaling cluster on the same cloud, so you never re-platform to handle traffic.

## Cloud instance questions

### What is a redu instance?

A real virtual machine with root and SSH access, provisioned by your agent or from the console, that you fully control.

### Can I use redu without an agent? [...] # Cloud instances on redu

Real virtual machines you fully control, like any cloud. Create one from the console or the API, or let your agent provision it. Root and SSH access, an automatic domain name, and attachable block storage, hosted in the EU.

Provisioned by your agent, billed by the hour, hosted in the EU.

## What you get

## How it works

## A real machine your agent stands up and operates.

Full virtual machines you control, provisioned and operated by your agent, so you spend time on the app, not on running servers.

### A real machine, not a sandbox

You get a full virtual machine with root and SSH, so your agent can get onto the box and fix a live problem in place, something a serverless slot will not let you do.

### Run it manually or with an agent [...] ### Can I use redu without an agent?

Yes. redu is a regular cloud you operate from the console or the API, the same as any other. An agent over the MCP is an optional, faster interface to the same actions.

### Can my AI agent create and operate an instance?

Yes. redu has a native MCP server, so any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code is the common example) provisions an instance, deploys to it, and can SSH in to fix it.

### Can I SSH into my instance?

Yes. Every instance is a real machine with SSH access, so you and your agent can get onto the box directly.

### How are instances priced?

By the hour, with no per-unit tax. New accounts start on a free tier. See the pricing page for exact rates.

### Where do instances run?
